config.goal: Explore a wide range of strategy types (momentum, mean-reversion, breakout, multi-asset) and accept the first strategy that clears the pass gate.
config.scope: strategy.py — any signal type, any of the 10 catalog symbols, any indicator period, any position-sizing scheme
config.metric: composite = gain_factor × win_rate; gate: gain_train > 1.0 AND win_rate_train >= 0.5
